test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years was a Hindu College in Benaras established to impart education from the ancient Sanskrit texts?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1791**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Hindu College in Benaras was established in **1791** by Jonathan Duncan, a British officer.
 
• The objective of the college was to promote the study of **Sanskrit texts and traditional Indian knowledge systems**.
 
• It was one of the earliest institutions in India to focus on **preserving and imparting classical Sanskrit education**.
 
• The institution later evolved into the **Government Sanskrit College** and played a critical role in the education system of the region.
 
• The establishment of the college was part of the British efforts to understand and govern Indian society better by studying its ancient texts and traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jonathan Duncan:** He was the British Resident in Benaras and initiated the establishment of the Hindu College to promote the study of Indian classical knowledge and culture.
 
• **Sanskrit Education:** Sanskrit was considered the language of ancient Indian scriptures, including the Vedas, Upanishads, and other philosophical texts.
 
• **Benaras (Varanasi):** Known as a center of learning and spirituality in India, Varanasi has been a hub for education and cultural preservation for centuries.
 
• **Impact on Higher Education:** The Hindu College laid the groundwork for future educational institutions that focused on blending traditional Indian education with modern methodologies.
 
• **Transition to Modern Institutions:** The college's legacy contributed to the establishment of institutions such as Banaras Hindu University (BHU), which continues to be a major center for higher education in India today.
